text.hi: तेज़ बारिश के दिन गाँव के स्कूल के हेडमास्टर बच्चों को बाढ़ के कारण, नुक़सान और बचाव के तरीक़े बताते हैं। यह पाठ तुम्हारी जान भी बचा सकता है!
text.hinglish: Tez baarish ke din gaanv ke school ke headmaster bachchon ko baadh ke kaaran, nuksaan aur bachaav ke tareeqe bataate hain. Yeh paath tumhari jaan bhi bacha sakta hai!
text.en: On a very rainy day, a village headmaster tells students the causes and effects of floods, and how to stay safe. This lesson could save your life!

steps.question: What happens when it rains heavily?

questionMeaning.hi: तेज़ बारिश होने पर क्या होता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Tez baarish hone par kya hota hai?

options: Rivers rise and there can be floods.
steps.answer: Rivers rise and there can be floods.
steps.modelAnswer: When it rains heavily, rivers and streams overflow, roads get blocked, and there can be floods.

modelMeaning.hi: तेज़ बारिश में नदी-नाले उफ़न जाते हैं, रास्ते बंद हो जाते हैं और बाढ़ आ सकती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Tez baarish mein nadi-naale ufan jaate hain, raaste band ho jaate hain aur baadh aa sakti hai.

steps.question: What will you do in case there is a flood?

questionMeaning.hi: बाढ़ आए तो तुम क्या करोगे?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Baadh aaye to tum kya karoge?

options: Move to a higher, safe place with my family.
Go near the river to watch.
steps.answer: Move to a higher, safe place with my family.
steps.modelAnswer: In case of a flood, I will not panic. I will move with my family to a higher, safe place like the school building.

modelMeaning.hi: बाढ़ आने पर मैं घबराऊँगा नहीं। परिवार के साथ ऊँची, सुरक्षित जगह जैसे स्कूल भवन में चला जाऊँगा।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Baadh aane par main ghabraaunga nahi. Parivaar ke saath oonchi, surakshit jagah jaise school bhavan mein chala jaaunga.

steps.question: ‘It's raining cats and dogs’ means ...
options: Animals are playing in the rain.

steps.meaning: a sudden event that causes great damage
very heavy rain in a short time

exampleMeaning.hi: बादल फटने से बाढ़ आ सकती है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Baadal phatne se baadh aa sakti hai.

steps.meaning: a wall of earth along a river
a disease that spreads to many people
very afraid and unable to think

steps.example: Take the cattle to a veterinary hospital.
